reason: A monitoring and observability plugin for DeepSeek Harness that collects bounded operational metrics and exposes them to Prometheus and Grafana without exporting conversation or tool payloads.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 收集受限的运行指标，并通过 Prometheus 与 Grafana 提供可观测性。
summaries.en: Collects bounded DeepSeek Harness runtime metrics and makes them available through Prometheus and Grafana for observability.

capabilities: Collects lifecycle, LLM, tool, subagent, and job metrics
Exposes Prometheus-compatible metrics over an HTTP endpoint
Provides Grafana dashboard and Prometheus integration
Supports optional remote endpoint exposure when explicitly configured
